app.name: FlowState
app.tagline: Your coding agents, without the terminal

nav.comingSoonText: this section is on its way.

chat.emptyText: Pick a project and describe the task. FlowState keeps your session so you can resume anytime.
chat.approveRetryConfirm: Switch this project to "Accept edits" mode and send your last request again?
chat.approveRetryNote: Permission granted: you may now make the edits. Please retry the request above.
chat.undoConfirm: Undo the last turn? The changes the agent made will be reverted with git.

composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
composer.disabledNoProject: Select or create a project to start.
composer.disabledVpn: Sending is disabled while a VPN is active. Disconnect it and recheck.
composer.disabledMissing: {agent} CLI was not found. Set its path in Settings.
composer.disabledLogin: Claude is not signed in. Sign in from the Claude CLI and recheck.

project.title: Project
project.name: Name
project.removeConfirm: Remove "{name}" from FlowState? Your files are not deleted.
project.noProjectsText: Add a folder to start working with an agent.

banner.vpn: VPN detected. Disconnect and use a regular network to reach Claude.
banner.claudeMissing: Claude CLI was not found. Set its path in Settings.
banner.notLoggedIn: Claude is not signed in. Sign in from the Claude CLI, then recheck.
banner.agyAlwaysProceed: AGY is running in always-proceed mode: changes are applied without asking.
banner.claudeMissingHint: Pick the claude.exe file in Settings.
banner.gitMissing: Git was not found, so auto-commit and undo are unavailable.

walkthrough.title: Set up your project
walkthrough.welcomeText: Let's get a project ready in a few steps.
walkthrough.prerequisitesText: We check that the tools you need are installed.
walkthrough.folderText: Choose the folder where the agent will work.
walkthrough.agentText: Pick the agent and the permission mode.
walkthrough.gitText: Enable git so every change is versioned and can be undone.
walkthrough.templateText: Start from a template or a methodology.
walkthrough.doneText: All set. Send your first prompt!
walkthrough.folderRequired: Choose a project folder to continue.

hint.claude: Install Claude Code from claude.ai/code and sign in.
hint.git: Install Git from git-scm.com to version changes.

prompts.title: Prompt templates
prompts.deleteConfirm: Delete the template "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
prompts.useNeedsProject: Select a project first to use a template in its chat.
prompts.insertedInComposer: Template inserted in the message box
prompts.exportNeedsProject: Select a project to export into
prompts.noVars: This template has no variables: it is used as written.
prompts.pickText: Select one on the left to fill it in, preview it and use it in your chat.
prompts.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Used as the file name.
prompts.idTaken: A template with this id already exists.
prompts.bodyHint: Write {{name}} wherever a value should go: each one becomes a form field.
prompts.varsNone: No variables yet. Add {{name}} to the text above.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.emptyText: Files and previews created by the agent show up here.

auth.loginStarted: A console window opened. Finish signing in there, then press Recheck.
auth.loginFailed: Could not start the sign-in flow.

prereq.installConfirm: FlowState will run winget to install {name} (package {pkg}) for your user account. It downloads files and Windows may ask for permission. Continue?
prereq.installing: Installing... this can take a few minutes.

files.revealTitle: Show this file in Windows Explorer
files.htmlHint: Static preview: scripts are blocked here. Open the file in your browser to see it fully.
files.truncated: Showing only the start of a large file ({size}).
files.binaryText: No preview available. Use Open to view it with another app.
files.pickText: Choose a file in the tree to preview it.

preview.emptyText: When the agent creates or edits a file, it is previewed here.

dashboard.pythonText: Dashboards run with Streamlit in a private Python environment. Install Python to continue.
dashboard.setupText: FlowState creates a private .venv in this project and installs streamlit, plotly and pandas. This runs once.
dashboard.noAppsText: Ask the agent to build one. Any Streamlit .py file in the project will show up here.
dashboard.askAgent: Ask the agent to build a dashboard

remote.label: Remote control
remote.tooltip: Lets you continue this session from claude.ai/code or the Claude phone app.
remote.tooltipShort: Continue this session from claude.ai/code or the phone app
remote.confirm: This exposes the session of this project to your own Claude account, so you can continue it from claude.ai/code or the Claude phone app. Anyone signed in to your account can see and drive it.
remote.confirmAgy: AGY note: this registers a background daemon tied to your Windows login (machine-wide, not just this project). It stays active until you turn remote control off.
remote.notSupported: Remote control is not supported for this agent or version.

history.clearConfirm: Delete the saved chat history of this project? Your files are not affected.

menu.removeConfirm: Remove "{name}" from FlowState? Your files and folder are NOT deleted: only this list entry and its saved history go away.
